title: Law to study city agencies' use of messaging apps
summary: This bill would require the Department of Records and Information Services to set up a working group studying how city agencies use instant messaging platforms like text or chat apps and how they retain records of those messages. Within 180 days of taking effect, the group must send the Mayor and Council Speaker a report on agency usage, existing policies and recommendations for record retention, which must then be posted on the department's website within 10 days. The working group would dissolve once it submits its report.
